Photograph of a real handcrafted storybook miniature painted in soft gouache colours: hand-painted carved wood with visible brush grain, felted wool and woven linen fabrics, matte chalky paint surfaces in sage green, apricot, slate teal and warm cream, soft warm late-afternoon light. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
